Scenario EMB-S1 (Anonymous tour of the four browse widgets) could not be executed because the clone (KMS at kms.r-s.workers.dev) exposes NO public/anonymous browse widgets at all — no sessions list, no speakers directory, no agenda/schedule view, and no speaker photo gallery are reachable while logged out.

What was checked while logged out:
- Home page ('/') outline: only "Demo admin login", "Demo speaker login", "Reset demo data", and two "Elsewhere" links — "Public call for speakers" (a CFP submission wizard) and "REST API docs".
- Tried ~15 plausible public routes: /sessions, /agenda, /speakers, /schedule, /gallery, /program, /widgets, /embeds, /public, /events, /explore, /event/ai-engineer-sandbox-event, /ai-engineer-sandbox-event, /agenda/devflow-conf-2027, /schedule/devflow-conf-2027 — all returned 404.
- The only functioning unauthenticated page besides the home screen is /submit/{event-slug}/{form-id}, a multi-step submission INTAKE wizard (Welcome → Account → Submission → Participant → Review) — this is the CFP form, not a browse/discovery surface, and it shows no session or speaker listings.
- /docs is a public API reference (Scalar/OpenAPI UI) but requires a Bearer token for any real data — not a browsing widget.
- /portal/devflow-conf-2027 (guessed second-event slug, confirmed valid via the organizer's event switcher) redirects an anonymous visitor to a magic-link sign-in request form — confirming the "Portal" is a speaker portal requiring auth, not a public attendee page, for either seeded event.

To rule out the content-approval-gate explanation given in the script's precondition, I signed into the pre-seeded organizer account (Demo admin login → magic link) and inspected Settings, Agenda, and the Portal link. Settings only exposes "API tokens", "API docs", and "Reset demo data" — no public-site toggle, share link, or embed-code feature exists anywhere in the admin app. The Agenda view is only reachable inside the authenticated admin app (/app?v=agenda). I then logged out fully without modifying any data (did not touch approval statuses, since the root cause is structural — no public pages exist to gate in the first place).

CONCLUSION: This is a genuine, structural absence of the "Public & Embeddable Widgets" feature area, not a data/seeding issue. None of the five success signals (sessions list/search/filter screenshots, agenda day-switch/detail screenshots, speaker gallery/search/detail screenshots) could be produced because the underlying pages do not exist for anonymous users. All findings and routes tried are recorded in the observation log.
observations:
EMB-S1 findings: Exhaustively searched for public/anonymous browse widgets (sessions list, speakers directory, agenda/schedule grid, speaker photo gallery) on this KMS clone. 

Routes tried while logged out (all returned 404 or were auth-gated): /sessions, /agenda, /schedule, /speakers, /gallery, /program, /widgets, /embeds, /public, /events, /explore, /event/ai-engineer-sandbox-event, /ai-engineer-sandbox-event, /agenda/devflow-conf-2027, /schedule/devflow-conf-2027.

The home page ('/') lists only two 'Elsewhere' links for anonymous users: 'Public call for speakers' (a multi-step CFP/submission wizard at /submit/{event-slug}/{form-id}) and 'REST API docs' (/docs, an OpenAPI/Scalar reference requiring a bearer token for any real data). Neither is a browse/discovery widget — the CFP form is a submission intake wizard (Welcome → Account → Submission → Participant → Review), not a session/speaker listing.

To be thorough I signed into the pre-seeded organizer account (Demo admin login, magic-link flow) to check whether a public site/embed toggle exists anywhere in Settings, Agenda, or elsewhere in the admin app. Settings only exposes 'API tokens' and 'API docs' (both auth-required) and a 'Reset demo data' button — no 'public page', 'embed code', or 'share link' feature was found. The Agenda section (/app?v=agenda) is only reachable inside the authenticated admin app. There is also a per-event 'Portal' (/portal/{event-slug}) but this is a SPEAKER portal requiring magic-link sign-in (shows 'My Submissions', 'My Profile', 'Tasks') — not a public attendee-facing directory; visiting /portal/devflow-conf-2027 while logged out shows a 'Sign in' / request-magic-link screen, confirming it is not public.

CONCLUSION: None of the four requested browse widgets (sessions list, sessions search/filters, speakers directory, agenda/schedule grid, speaker photo gallery) exist as anonymous/public-facing surfaces in this clone. The only unauthenticated route is the CFP submission form. I logged back out after this admin exploration (no data was created or modified). This is a significant gap versus the SessionBoard-style 'Public & Embeddable Widgets' feature area: the product has no public program/agenda/speaker-gallery pages at all — everything session/speaker-related lives behind either the admin app or the speaker portal, both requiring authentication.

Final summary for EMB-S1: Of the four required public browse widgets (sessions list, speakers directory, agenda/schedule, speaker photo gallery), ZERO were reachable anonymously. The app's only logged-out surfaces are: (1) the home/login-chooser page with demo-login buttons, (2) the CFP submission wizard at /submit/{event}/{form-id}, and (3) the API docs reference (which itself requires a bearer token to return real data). Steps 3-10 of the script (sessions list/search/filters, speakers list detail, agenda day-switching/detail, speaker gallery search/detail, consistency sampling) could not be executed because no such public pages exist — this is a genuine capability gap, not a data-labeling mismatch. I verified this by: trying ~15 plausible URLs (/sessions, /agenda, /schedule, /speakers, /gallery, /program, /widgets, /embeds, /public, /events, /explore, event-slug variants) all 404; checking the home page's only two 'Elsewhere' links; and signing into the seeded organizer account to check Settings/Agenda for any public-link or embed-code feature (none found — Settings only has API tokens/docs/demo-reset). I signed back out afterward without altering any data. No 'DevFlow Conf 2027' public content is exposed either, though that event does exist in the organizer's event switcher and has its own speaker-portal login gate (also auth-required, confirmed via /portal/devflow-conf-2027 showing a magic-link request form to an anonymous visitor).

scenarios.summary:
Searched exhaustively for a public/embeddable "Schedule Itinerary" or "My Schedule" widget in KMS (https://kms.r-s.workers.dev), logged out and logged in.

What exists:
- Logged-out homepage exposes only two public links: a CFP submission form ("Public call for speakers") and REST API docs. No agenda/schedule/itinerary link in any nav or footer.
- Direct URL guesses (/agenda, /schedule, /itinerary, /e/{slug}, /e/{slug}/agenda, /widget/{slug}, /embed/agenda) all 404.
- Logged in via the seeded "Demo admin login" and found an internal, authenticated Agenda builder (day/week/month/room drag-and-drop scheduling) for organizers, present for both the seeded "AI.Engineer Sandbox Event – NYC" and a second event "DevFlow Conf 2027" (confirming the app does support multiple events, switchable via an event-filter dropdown and a "Create a new event" button in the admin sidebar).
- The Agenda builder has a Publish toggle that exposes a truly public, unauthenticated URL: /e/{slug}/agenda.json. I published the NYC event's agenda and confirmed this returns a raw JSON blob (event/rooms/tracks/sessions with ISO timestamps) — not an HTML page. It has no day tabs, no session cards, no descriptions rendered as UI, no keyword search or track filters, no star/heart/bookmark/"Add to schedule" controls, no personal-schedule view, and no calendar/ICS export button. It is a machine-readable feed intended for external consumption, not a browsable itinerary widget.
- The Speaker Portal (/portal/{slug}) is an authenticated speaker-only area (submissions, profile, tasks) with nothing resembling attendee schedule browsing.
- Admin Settings only offers API-token management; no public-widget/embed configuration was found.

Because there is no attendee-facing itinerary page at all (only an organizer-only builder plus a raw JSON export), none of the scenario's steps 2–10 (day-tab browsing, session-card anatomy, search/filter, personal-schedule bookmarking, persistence-after-reload, add-to-calendar export, remove-from-schedule) could be exercised — the underlying capability (a public/embeddable schedule-itinerary widget with personal-schedule building) does not exist in this product. This is reported as feature_not_found rather than blocked, since the search was thorough (public nav, URL guessing, authenticated admin exploration, settings, docs) and no such UI surface was found anywhere, only a data feed and an internal admin scheduler.

Screenshots captured: homepage (logged out), admin dashboard, DevFlow Conf 2027 empty agenda, AI.Engineer Sandbox agenda builder (Draft then Published), and the raw public agenda.json feed content, documenting the absence of an itinerary widget.

scenarios.scenarioName: Organizer embed generation and data consistency
scenarios.summary:
Signed in as the seeded organizer (james@atelyr.com, via the app's magic-link demo login) at https://kms.r-s.workers.dev. Multi-event support is present: the account has two events, 'AI.Engineer Sandbox Event – NYC' (fully seeded with submissions/agenda) and 'DevFlow Conf 2027' (pre-seeded but empty of submissions/sessions), switchable via an event-filter dropdown, plus a '+ Create a new event' button.

Systematically searched every admin nav section (Dashboard, Workspace, Speakers, Submissions, Tasks, Messages, Forms, Evaluation, Review, Agenda, Settings) for an Embeds/Widgets/Share/Publish/Integrations module as described in the scenario. FINDING: no such module exists. There is no embed-type picker (sessions list / speakers list / agenda / schedule itinerary / speaker gallery), no output-format picker (styled HTML+script tag / basic HTML / JSON-as-a-product / XML / iCal), no snippet generator, no preview affordance, no CSS/branding customization, and no field-selection checkboxes anywhere in the product. This is a clear capability gap versus the scenario's expectations, recorded as an explicit observation.

The only public/embeddable surface discovered is a 'Publish'/'Unpublish' toggle on the Agenda screen, whose tooltip reads 'Publish the agenda to the public feed (/e/slug/agenda.json)'. Toggling it activates a bare unauthenticated JSON endpoint (confirmed working for both events) with no HTML wrapper, embed snippet, or styling — the closest functional equivalent to a 'sessions/agenda widget' but missing all builder chrome. Confirmed 404s on plausible alternate feed paths: /e/<slug>/speakers.json, /e/<slug>/speakers, /e/<slug>/agenda (HTML), /e/<slug>/agenda.ics, and /e/<slug> root — so no speaker-gallery or iCal equivalents exist either.

Despite the missing embed-builder UI, I still verified the CONSISTENCY requirement using the one real public artifact: for session SESS-1 'Building Reliable Multi-Agent Pipelines with Tool-Use Guardrails' on the AI.Engineer Sandbox event, the organizer-side Agenda list view (title, speaker Ada Lovelace, track 'Agents', format 'Talk', room 'Main Stage', 'Mon, Oct 12 · 9 AM – 9:45 AM') exactly matches the public JSON feed's record (same title, track_id resolving to 'Agents', room_id resolving to 'Main Stage', starts_at/ends_at converting to 9:00–9:45 AM PDT, same speaker) — no discrepancies found. Screenshots captured: organizer-agenda-sess1, organizer-session-list-detail, public-agenda-json-feed. No embed-builder screenshots could be captured because that feature does not exist in this clone (recorded as an explicit finding rather than papered over).
observations: EMBED/WIDGET FEATURE SEARCH RESULTS: Explored all admin nav sections (Dashboard, Workspace, Speakers, Submissions, Tasks, Messages, Forms, Evaluation, Review, Agenda, Settings) for both the pre-seeded 'AI.Engineer Sandbox Event – NYC' and the pre-seeded 'DevFlow Conf 2027' event (found via the event-filter dropdown; multi-event support IS present — two events already exist and can be switched via a select control, with a '+ Create a new event' button also available). NO dedicated Embeds/Widgets/Share/Publish/Integrations module exists anywhere in the admin UI. There is no widget-type picker (no sessions-list/speakers-list/agenda/schedule-itinerary/speaker-gallery choices), no output-format picker (no styled HTML/script-tag, basic HTML, XML, or iCal options), no CSS/branding customization, no content filters, and no field-selection checkboxes — none of the EMB-S3 script's expected embed-builder screens exist.

The ONLY public/embeddable surface found is on the Agenda page: a 'Publish'/'Unpublish' toggle button labeled 'Publish the agenda to the public feed (/e/slug/agenda.json)'. Clicking it flips the agenda status badge from 'Draft' to 'Published' and activates a raw JSON endpoint at https://kms.r-s.workers.dev/e/<event-slug>/agenda.json (confirmed working for both events, e.g. /e/devflow-conf-2027/agenda.json returned an empty-sessions JSON object, and /e/ai-engineer-sandbox-event/agenda.json returned full session data). This is a bare unauthenticated JSON API response (no HTML wrapper, no <script> embed snippet, no shareable page) — it is the closest equivalent to a 'sessions/agenda widget' but has none of the builder chrome (no snippet generator, no preview, no styling/format options) described in the scenario. No .ics, .xml, or speakers.json/speakers HTML equivalents exist (confirmed 404 on /e/<slug>/speakers.json, /e/<slug>/speakers, /e/<slug>/agenda, /e/<slug>/agenda.ics, and /e/<slug> root).

CONSISTENCY CHECK (organizer record vs public feed) — session SESS-1 on 'AI.Engineer Sandbox Event – NYC' (the only event with real scheduled data; DevFlow Conf 2027 is pre-seeded but empty of submissions/sessions). Organizer-side Agenda > List view shows: Title 'Building Reliable Multi-Agent Pipelines with Tool-Use Guardrails', Speaker 'Ada Lovelace', Track 'Agents', Format 'Talk', Room 'Main Stage', When 'Mon, Oct 12 · 9 AM – 9:45 AM', Duration 45 min (screenshot: organizer-session-list-detail). The public JSON feed at /e/ai-engineer-sandbox-event/agenda.json (screenshot: public-agenda-json-feed) shows the same session: title identical, track_id resolves to track name 'Agents' (color #6366f1), room_id resolves to 'Main Stage', starts_at '2026-10-12T16:00:00Z' / ends_at '...16:45:00Z' which converts to 9:00–9:45 AM in the event's America/Los_Angeles (PDT, UTC-7) timezone shown in the admin — an exact match, speaker 'Ada Lovelace' also matches. No discrepancies found between organizer-side record and the public feed data for this session.
